people.name: Succoth
people.line: City in Canaan, location of Solomon's bronze works

translations.web: He took the elders of the city, and thorns of the wilderness and briers, and with them he taught the men of Succoth.
translations.bsb: Then he took the elders of the city, and using the thorns and briers of the wilderness, he disciplined the men of Succoth.
translations.kjv: And he took the elders of the city, and thorns of the wilderness and briers, and with them he taught the men of Succoth.
translations.asv: And he took the elders of the city, and thorns of the wilderness and briers, and with them he taught the men of Succoth.
